name: AR_PAY_REL_ASSIGNMENTS
description: This table stores assignments between an existing customer hierarchy type (or tree structure) to one of the seeded paying relationship functions.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_ID
columns.description: Paying relationship assignment identifier.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: ASSIGNMENT_TYPE
columns.description: Indicates which paying relationship function is to associate with an assignment.

columns.name: TREE_STRUCTURE_CODE
columns.description: Paying Relationship assignment tree structure name based on tree structures defined under Trading Community Architecture lookup for party hierarchy tree structures.

columns.name: START_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: Indicates the first date of a date range that a given paying relationship assignment is available for use.

columns.name: END_DATE_ACTIVE
columns.description: Indicates the last date of a date range that a given paying relationship assignment is available for use.

columns.name: STATUS
columns.description: Indicates whether a given paying relationship assignment is available for use, as determined by the assignment date range.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATED_BY_MODULE
columns.description: Oracle internal use only.
